_doc: Role-to-capability policy (Prompt 7) -- SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
The .NET middleware loads this file to build ASP.NET Core authorization
policies; the Python agent-service loads the SAME file to re-check the
approval-level rule as a second layer. Keep one copy; the demo mounts it
site_scope: 'single' means the user's site_id claim gates every incident
query -- a Site 07 user requesting Site 12 data is rejected server-side.
max_approval_level: the highest HITL level this role may decide.
PlantManager         -> 3 (can decide Level 2 AND Level 3 'Controlled Action')
ENFORCED INDEPENDENTLY BY BOTH SERVICES (defense in depth): the .NET
policy handler returns 403 before the call leaves the middleware; the
Python decision endpoints re-validate role + level + site from the
forwarded token. Neither layer is the only check.

Operator.description: View own-site incidents, evidence, root cause, risk, recommendations; use the Why? chat. Cannot approve or reject.

MaintenanceEngineer.description: Everything an Operator can do, plus approve/reject HITL Level 2 recommendations for their own site.

PlantManager.description: Everything a MaintenanceEngineer can do, plus approve/reject HITL Level 3 (Controlled Action) recommendations for their own site.
